name: T3 Code
description: Controls the coding agents already on your machine, such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and OpenCode, from a desktop, web or mobile app backed by a local server started with the t3 CLI.

skills.name: Remote Access
skills.description: Connects a phone, browser or another desktop to a T3 Code host through T3 Connect or the t3 connect command, without router forwarding.

skills.name: Permission Modes
skills.description: Sets per-thread approval rules, from Supervised to Auto-accept edits, Auto or Full access, with project and environment defaults.

skills.name: Source Control Integrations
skills.description: Clones and publishes repositories, creates pull requests and reviews changes on GitHub, GitLab, Forgejo, Gitea, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps.

skills.name: Background Service
skills.description: Installs T3 Code as a per-user service on Linux and macOS with t3 service install, so agents stay reachable without an open terminal.
